title: Lipid nanoparticles chart path beyond the liver - Nature Biotechnology
gist: Only the standfirst of this feature is accessible before a login/subscription wall: a new generation of RNA therapies delivered by lipid nanoparticles is being aimed at extrahepatic tissues. The remaining accessible text is access-gate boilerplate plus author attribution to Andrew Marshall (New York), who discloses consulting for Haystack Science while stating no company mentioned in the story is a client.

themes.theme: LNP delivery moving past the liver

insights.claim: A new generation of RNA therapies delivered by lipid nanoparticles is being targeted at extrahepatic tissues rather than the liver.
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
insights.so_what: Liver tropism has been the structural ceiling on the addressable market for LNP-delivered RNA drugs; credible extrahepatic targeting would widen the indication set well beyond rare hepatic and vaccine uses.
insights.quote: A new generation of RNA therapies delivered by lipid nanoparticles takes aim at extrahepatic tissues.
insights.locator: A new generation of RNA therapies

insights.claim: Framing extrahepatic delivery as the defining feature of a 'new generation' of lipid nanoparticles implies the field treats tissue targeting, not payload chemistry, as the current rate-limiting problem in RNA therapeutics.
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
insights.so_what: Value in RNA therapeutics is migrating toward delivery IP and tissue-tropism platforms rather than the RNA sequence itself — relevant to how licensing economics are split.
insights.locator: A new generation of RNA therapies

insights.claim: The piece is written by Andrew Marshall, based in New York, who discloses consulting for Haystack Science and explicitly states that no company mentioned in the story is a client.
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
insights.so_what: The pre-emptive conflict disclosure signals the article names specific commercial players, so the gated body likely contains company-level competitive detail worth retrieving in full.
insights.quote: A.M. consults for Haystack Science; no company mentioned in this story is a client.

insights.claim: Substantive content on extrahepatic lipid nanoparticle delivery sits behind a login/subscription gate, so only the thesis statement and not the supporting evidence or company specifics is available from this record.
